description:
One agreement you are in, with the exact bytes that were agreed to as hashn kept them (text as text, other
    bytes as base64 with encoding='base64'). Works with or without the workspace the file sat in. hashn keeps a copy
    of an agreed file up to 1 MiB; where it kept none (`copy_kept` false), the answer still gives the SHA-256, which
    proves any copy you kept yourself. Keep your own copy of what you agree to.

agreement_id.description: The agreement's id (a UUID), from list_agreements or the `entry` of an agree answer.
agreement_id.title: Agreement Id

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

name: read_agreement
